editorial: Maleficent gives a fresh spin on Sleeping Beauty by telling the story from the villain's side. You meet a kind fairy who protects her forest home, then gets hurt by someone she trusted. That pain turns her cold, and she curses baby Aurora. As the girl grows, you see Maleficent soften and question her own revenge. The movie looks rich and magical, with big battles, glowing forests, and a strong lead performance that carries the emotion. It moves at a steady pace, mixing family-friendly wonder with darker moments, so younger kids may need a parent nearby. The story is simple and easy to follow, though some side characters feel thin. If you enjoy fantasy with heart, this is a fun pick. Watch it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Maleficent realizes she truly loves Aurora and breaks the curse with a kiss on her forehead. Stefan attacks her with iron, but Diaval turns into a dragon and helps her escape. Stefan falls to his death during the fight. In the end, Aurora becomes queen of both kingdoms, and Maleficent flies free with her wings restored, ending on peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves fantasy fairy tales with a darker twist.
